name: Avatar/Single
description:
Represents a person or a workspace with a photo or initials.


Use for
People lists, assignees, account switchers, chat.


Use something else
Brand logos and categories → Dock-Icon.
Decorative illustrations.


Properties
Theme: Photo, or a colour family for initials
Background: Solid (initials in On-Colors; the default in table Avatar-Cells) · Subtle
Size: 2XSmall–3XLarge: 40px (Medium) in list rows, 32px in captioned popover items
Status: the presence dot


Code: <Avatar> (Zen DS)
